All four candidates are direct matches by concept: two target "Peripheral vascular disease, unspecified" (PGS001843, PGS002055; EFO peripheral vascular disease) and two target "Peripheral artery disease" (PGS005158, PGS005217; EFO peripheral arterial disease), which is closely aligned to the target peripheral vascular disease. The main limitation is that none of the candidates report clearly PRS-only AUROC/R2; the UKB portability scores (PGS001843/PGS002055) provide only small partial-r values and come from a portability framework paper, while PGS005158 is GWAS-hits (19 variants) and restricted to type 2 diabetes phenotyping. Given missing PRS-only metrics and some endpoint heterogeneity (PVD unspecified vs PAD incident vs PAD-in-T2D), the recommendation is direct but sub-optimal rather than high-confidence.
